events.title: The Cimbri and Teutons crush two Roman armies at Arausio
events.description: Between Arausio, now Orange, and the Rhône, the Cimbri under Boiorix and the Teutons under Teutobod defeated two Roman armies under the proconsul Quintus Servilius Caepio and the consul Gnaeus Mallius Maximus. It was Rome's worst defeat of the Cimbrian War.

events.title: Lucullus defeats Tigranes the Great at Tigranocerta
events.description: In the Third Mithridatic War, a Roman army under the consul Lucius Licinius Lucullus defeated King Tigranes the Great of Armenia and captured his capital, Tigranocerta. The war ended with Armenia an allied client state of Rome.

events.title: Rebels kill Wang Mang as Chang'an falls
events.description: Rebel forces broke into Chang'an and killed Wang Mang, the usurper who had founded the Xin dynasty. His death cleared the way for the restoration of the Han dynasty under Emperor Guangwu.

events.title: Wang Shichong defeats Li Mi at the Battle of Yanshi
events.description: Blockaded in Luoyang for months, Wang Shichong led his troops out and surprised Li Mi's besieging army north of Yanshi, winning a decisive victory. Li's followers joined Wang, who later deposed the Sui puppet ruler Yang Tong.

events.title: Peri's Euridice, the oldest surviving opera, is performed
events.description: Jacopo Peri's Euridice was staged at the Pitti Palace in Florence during celebrations for the marriage of Maria de' Medici to Henry IV of France. It is the earliest opera whose music survives complete.

events.title: The Jazz Singer premieres in New York
events.description: Warner Bros released The Jazz Singer, starring Al Jolson, the first feature film with synchronised dialogue and singing. Its success ended the silent era within a few years.

events.title: Egypt and Syria attack Israel on Yom Kippur
events.description: Egyptian and Syrian forces launched surprise attacks on Israeli positions in Sinai and the Golan Heights on the holiest day of the Jewish year. The war ended in Israeli counter-offensives and reshaped Middle Eastern diplomacy.

events.title: Egyptian president Anwar Sadat is assassinated
events.description: Islamist army officers shot Anwar Sadat during a military parade in Cairo marking the 1973 war. Sadat had signed a peace treaty with Israel in 1979 and shared the Nobel Peace Prize with Menachem Begin.
